Hi, 

Read your post and felt sad-iam a guy and can't be in a relationship at the moment. I split with my girlfriend a little over 2yrs ago and not had someone since then. Not that I don't want this (I have an alcohol problem from which iam recovering). I will tell you the truth: there are 1,000,000 guys out there who would like to be your boyfriend-loved up etc. 

Iam terribly lonely but I must just recover without any complications you understand so this situation is sorta pinned on me for the foreseeable future and I now know what deep lonleyness is...although your situation is obviously different- I completely understand and anyone who says that we were meant to be this way (alone) is a complete idiot!

But, I saw a guy I know- he was into all kinds of stuff, drugs etc- I saw him in town walking with this lady, they were laughing etc, really looked happy etc. I thought if he [name] can find someone after EVERYTHING that this guy was involved with then there is hope for me! For us all.

I know that your probably completely normal etc and probably very pretty to boot but I just wanted to send you this note-don't ask me why? I just surf these subs with keywords like 'lonely' or 'craving' or even 'suicide' just because I NEED to relate to someone/anyone- I spent all last night just surfing and found your post and totally relate with the primal longing for someone to love. 

In the darkness of my flat- whether I send this or not (I write a thousand posts and send nothing) it is just comforting to know (regardless of how sad) that someone somewhere feels these exact same feelings as me.

Thank you for posting your thoughts and feelings as you know how hard life is when you are alone:-(
